title: Boltz-2 affinity predictions guide discovery of nanomolar CDK2 inhibitors
summary: A hit discovery platform combined the Boltz-2 cofolding affinity module with a custom screening space of stereochemically complex tetrahydroquinolines made by a single-step multicomponent reaction. Boltz-2 guided both the initial high-throughput virtual screening and the subsequent hit optimization, which the abstract says yielded nanomolar inhibitors of cyclin-dependent kinase 2 (CDK2). The abstract gives no assay details or IC50 values and this is a v1 preprint.
ai_technology: Boltz-2 cofolding affinity module used for virtual screening and hit optimization

evidence.tested: Nanomolar CDK2 inhibition reported for compounds from the Boltz-2-guided screen and optimization.
